title: Total Covered Length
summary: Return the total length covered by the union of half-open intervals.
statement: Return the total length covered by the union of half-open intervals. Implement `total_covered_length` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Overlapping intervals contribute only their combined outer span.
Sort, extend the current union segment, and add it when a gap begins.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the total_covered_length invariant is complete.
Editorial: Sort, extend the current union segment, and add it when a gap begins. The intended bounds are O(n log n) time and O(1) space.
